name: NoSuggest
tagline: YouTube on your terms NoSuggest is a distraction-free YouTube experience for people who want to watch **intentionally**, not endlessly
description: YouTube on your terms NoSuggest is a distraction-free YouTube experience for people who want to watch **intentionally**, not endlessly. Instead of a homepage engineered to keep you scrolling, NoSuggest shows you only the latest videos from channels you deliberately choose to follow. Nothing more. What's removed - No recommendation algorithm - No autoplay - No Shorts - No homepage - No suggested videos pulling you into rabbit holes What stays - Your chosen channels - Their latest 5 videos, newest
